name: cpu_operator_cost
description: Sets the query planner's estimated cost of executing each operator or function call during query execution.
symptoms: Excessive use of sequential scans over indexes
Unexpectedly slow queries despite available indexes
tuning_tips: Decrease this value to make CPU-bound operations appear cheaper, encouraging more complex plans (e.g., index scans, nested loops); increase it to favor I/O-efficient plans (e.g., sequential scans, hash joins). Tune in concert with other cost constants and validate using EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
